title: [W]Return to a draft or submitted response

returnToDraft.heading: [W]Return to a draft response
returnToDraft.intro: [W]You can return to a draft response by using:
returnToDraft.bullet1: [W]the account details you used when you started the response
returnToDraft.bullet2: [W]your save and return number, for example A7F9-K3P2

returnToSubmitted.heading: [W]Return to a submitted response
returnToSubmitted.intro: [W]You can return to a submitted response by:
returnToSubmitted.bullet1: [W]using the account details you used when you submitted the response
returnToSubmitted.bullet2: [W]creating an account. You can only access responses where the case number starts with 6 or 8.

mainQuestion.question: [W]What type of response do you want to return to?
mainQuestion.option1: [W]I want to return to a draft response
mainQuestion.option2: [W]I want to access or return to a submitted response

submittedOption.option2: [W]I have a response but no Employment Tribunal account
submittedOption.supportingText: [W]You will be able to create an account and access the response if the case number starts with a 6 or 8.
